settings.seo_title_1: The signature shirt, with the sleeves left on
settings.seo_text_1:
The same cut as the short sleeve signature: fitted through the chest and taken in at the waist, so it holds a shape instead of hanging off one.

The sleeve is cut to sit clean when it is down and stay put when it is rolled, which is most of the reason to own one.
